description: Republish a retained prior graph version as the next version. The publishing agent must manually write the four plain-language changeNarrative sections.

changeNarrative.description: Write four short, privacy-filtered summaries: added, updated, removed and relationships. Describe what changed in the graph; use a plain statement when a section has no changes.

expectedProjectVersion.description: Current hosted project version from get_project_status; guards against overwriting a newer graph publication.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

projectId.description: Owned project ID returned by list_linked_projects or map_project; do not use a local path or repository URL.

restoreVersion.description: Saved graph version selected for restoration.

sessionId.description: Active session record.id from start_agent_session for this project. Pass it on later project calls after starting the session.

name: restore_project_version
title: Restore project version
